question: Dhangar dance comes from the Dhangar community of ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhangar dance** is a** folk dance** that originated from the **Dhangar community of Goa.**
 
• This dance form is mainly performed during the **annual Dhangar fair,** which is celebrated in the month of **January or February.**
 
• The dance is performed in a** circle **and is accompanied by the beats of the** dhol, tasha **and other traditional musical instruments.
 
• The dancers wear traditional attire, which includes a **dhoti, a turban, and a waistcoat for men,** and a** saree and jewelry **for women.
 
• Dhangar dance is a significant part of the** Goan culture** and is performed to honor the** deities and seek their blessings**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andhra Pradesh** is known for its** Kuchipudi dance**, which is a classical dance form.
 
• **Gujarat** is famous for **Garba, **a folk dance that is performed during the **Navratri festival.**
 
• **Tamil Nadu** is known for **Bharatanatyam**, which is a classical dance form that originated in the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Goa** is a state in western India, known for its **beaches, nightlife, and rich culture**.
 
 
• Apart from Dhangar dance, Goa is also known for its folk dance forms like **Fugdi, Goff, and Kunbi dance.**
